test_title: PYST 39: RRB Group D - Reasoning (Held On: 14 Dec, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Which of the following numbers will replace the question marks (?) in the given series?

10, 2, 15, 3, 20, 5, 25, 7, ?, ?
solution:
**Given: **10, 2, 15, 3, 20, 5, 25, 7, ?, ?

The logic followed here is:

Series 1: Terms at odd positions: +5 each time

Series 2 is: Consecutive Prime Numbers starting from 2.

The prime numbers are: 2, 3, 5, 7, ...

The next prime number after 7 is 11.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a53d8cc6033a8e13580e07ac301562479bae94a4297cfa98d4a543ee93afb0ac.png] 

Thus, 30, 11 will replace the question marks (?) in the given series.

Hence, the correct answer is "**Option 2**".
